_how: Colours follow the part name, so a part looks the same on every page. Names are normalized (lowercase, plurals and '(1x)' stripped, '5x8mm' -> '5x8 mm'). Pin a part to a named colour here (the build lists the colour names if you use one it doesn't know); everything else is assigned automatically so that parts sharing a photo never share a colour. See .build/part-colors.generated.json for what was chosen.
